title: refactor(ui)!: retire zero-consumer exports from `@object-ui/collaboration` and `@object-ui/mobile`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDNjQXVZgdT2wbAyWd5s4eX)_

Part of #25921 — the per-package zero-reference barrel batch for `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer`, `@object-ui/collaboration` and `@object-ui/mobile` (claim 6541128113). The card stays open: the other items it lists are untouched, and this PR does not finish the batch for gantt or designer (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` names any of the eight retired exports (repo-wide `git grep -w`, zero hits each)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从 `@object-ui/collaboration` 入口去掉 `useCommentSearch`（连同模块）、它的两个类型和 `createPresenceUpdater`；从 `@object-ui/mobile` 入口去掉 `useOfflineSync`（连同模块）、`OfflineSyncState`、`requestBackgroundSync` 和 `resolveResponsiveValue`。共 8 个名字，每包一个 `!` changeset。
- 为什么改：这 8 个名字在全仓（含 `examples/**`、`packages/console`、文档和技能）除自己包以外零引用，README 也没教；继续发布只是没人用的公开面。
- 风险与回滚：仓内没有任何消费者，Console 和其它 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响；外部 npm 用户若用到会在升级时编译报错，changeset 里写了每个名字的替代写法。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/mobile/src/index.ts`、`ui/packages/collaboration/src/index.ts`、`.changeset/25921-mobile-zero-consumer-exports.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -w -e useOfflineSync -e useCommentSearch -e requestBackgroundSync -e resolveResponsiveValue -e createPresenceUpdater -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!.changeset/**'`，预期只剩 mobile/collaboration 自己的模块内定义与内部调用。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（入队前欠一次契约复审档的复审）。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/collaboration`: the entry stops exporting `useCommentSearch`, `CommentSearchConfig`, `CommentSearchReturn` and `createPresenceUpdater`. `src/useCommentSearch.ts` is deleted: the barrel was its only importer and it had no test. `createPresenceUpdater` stays in `usePresence.ts` (that module is also imported by `PresenceAvatars`), it only leaves the entry.
- `@object-ui/mobile`: the entry stops exporting `useOfflineSync`, `OfflineSyncState`, `requestBackgroundSync` and `resolveResponsiveValue`. `src/useOfflineSync.ts` is deleted: the barrel was its only importer and it had no test. `requestBackgroundSync` stays in `serviceWorkerSource.ts` (beside the kept `getServiceWorkerSource`) and `resolveResponsiveValue` stays in `breakpoints.ts` (`useResponsive` calls it; `breakpoints.test.ts` imports it from the module, unchanged).
- Two changesets, `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`), each with the `**BREAKING**` banner, the ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` marker naming every operand, and one FROM → TO line per name.

## How the set was chosen

Every name each barrel exports was listed from the barrel's AST (35 / 38 / 38 / 51), then `git grep -l -w -F` ran for each over the whole tree at `origin/main` `a878ff6c` minus the package's own directory, `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `.changeset/**` and `ui/.changeset/**`. Positive controls with the same command: `useRecordPresence` 101 files, `ResponsiveContainer` 89, `ObjectGantt` 108. A name was retired only when all three hold:

1. zero hits outside its package (any hit, prose included, keeps the name);
2. the package's own `README.md` / `demo` / `docs` do not name it (`check-readme-exports` holds every README self-import to a real export, and the READMEs are outside this claim's surface);
3. no export that stays needs it: a prop, option or result type of a kept component or hook stays, and so does the offline queue family (`createOfflineQueue`, the two queue classes, `generateOpId`, `OfflineQueueBackend`, `OfflineOperation`), because the kept `createOfflineDataSource` requires `queue: OfflineQueueBackend`.

| package | barrel names | zero hits outside | of those, named by the package README/demo | of those, needed by a kept export | retired here |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` | 35 | 24 | 24 | — | 0 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-designer` | 38 | 15 | 6 | 9 | 0 |
| `@object-ui/collaboration` | 38 | 18 | 0 | 14 | 4 |
| `@object-ui/mobile` | 51 | 24 | 1 | 19 | 4 |

## Tests

Read at code head `1c0cadd8` (the later merge commit `b6c6ff29` brings 5 `origin/main` commits, none under the four packages; the derived command list re-computed on it is identical).

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/collaboration --filter @object-ui/mobile run type-check` → both `Done` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/collaboration packages/mobile` → 13 files, 133 tests passed (os-verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- Public surface moved, so the direct importers were type-checked after the console closure build (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console...` 71/71, then `--filter=./ui/packages/*` 73/73): `@object-ui/app-shell`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-timeline` and `@object-ui/console` `type-check` all `Done`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` → 169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4901 tests passed.
- Full dogfood battery (the title carries `!`): closure `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/dogfood^...` 68/68, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` → Test Files 361 passed, 3 skipped (364); Tests 2917 passed, 28 skipped (2945); `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held the lock 1385 s.
- No ablation: export lines removed and two untested modules deleted; no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **gantt and designer yield nothing under this claim's surface.** All 24 zero-hit gantt names (`QuickFilterBar`, `ResourceWorkload`, `computeWorkload`, the `shifts` helpers and their types, …) are taught in `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/README.md`; the 6 zero-hit designer values (`CollaborationProvider`, `ConnectionStatusIndicator`, `useClipboard`, `useMultiSelect`, `useCanvasPanZoom`, `PropertyEditor`) are taught in `ui/packages/plugin-designer/README.md`. Retiring them needs a README edit in the same PR, which is outside the claimed file surface; the other 9 designer names are the `…Props` types of components that stay exported. Whether documented exports are in scope at all is the seat's call.
- `createPresenceUpdater` (in `usePresence.ts`) and `requestBackgroundSync` (in `serviceWorkerSource.ts`) are now exported by their modules only and read by nothing; deleting their bodies edits modules the claim does not cover, so they are left for the next pass.
- `CommentSearchResult` in `@object-ui/types` loses its only code reader with `useCommentSearch` (a test in that package still names it); that is another package's batch. `CommentEntry` keeps `plugin-detail`'s `RecordComments` as a reader.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates — 28/28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 28 commands; `--ran` with an exit code on every line: "28 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Every command exit 0, among them `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (re-run on `b6c6ff29`: exit 0), `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:published-files`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports` and `vitest run scripts/`.

Outside the derived set: `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (0 anchored files); `eslint` on the two changed barrels exit 0; `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` exit 0. `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; 214 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.

</details>
